Container.Name: CouchElephant
Container.Overview:
CouchElephant is an add-on for Plex. Plex's DVR records the wrong broadcast: ask it to record your team and it picks the repeat that airs two days later, on a channel you do not watch, and says nothing. Nor can you watch a recording from the start while it is still being made.
CouchElephant reads the same guide and picks the live airing itself. It needs a Plex Media Server, and Plex still lists everything. Plex can keep recording, with each airing pinned to an exact channel and time. Or turn on the CouchElephant DVR. It records from a network tuner, skips ads, and moves each finished recording into the Plex library folders you choose. It writes the recordings it makes there and nothing else.
It adds what Plex lacks. Follow any of 1,300 pro and college teams and it records every game. Build smart filters from AND, OR and NOT. Passes can wait for TV not yet in the guide, using TVmaze and TheSportsDB. It alerts Discord, Telegram or Notifiarr when Plex's guide goes stale. Apple TV, iPhone and iPad apps for live TV, the guide and recordings are on TestFlight now.
Setup is one button, Sign in with Plex. A new install starts in preview mode: it shows which airing each rule would take, and writes nothing to your DVR. The apps find the server on your home network only with Network Type set to Host. On bridge, type the address in the app.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex dvr recording sports guide epg
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server with Plex DVR already set up, which means Plex Pass and a tuner. The CouchElephant DVR is optional and needs a network tuner (HDHomeRun), plus the Recordings and Plex library paths below. It writes recordings into those folders and touches nothing else. For app discovery, set Network Type to Host.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database, your channel artwork, and any snapshots you schedule. The guide is a cache and rebuilds itself from Plex, so this stays small.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Only for the CouchElephant DVR. Where it records from the tuner before a recording moves into Plex. Fast disk or cache pool is best.

Config.Name: Plex library
Config.Description: Only for the CouchElephant DVR. The share that holds your Plex TV and Movies folders, such as /mnt/user/media. Finished recordings are copied into the folders you pick under Settings, Recording.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: The container's clock. Guide times are stored as UTC and shown in whichever timezone you pick under Settings, so this only affects the log.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user CouchElephant runs as. Match the user Plex runs as (99 is nobody on Unraid), so CouchElephant can write into every folder Plex makes. Settings, Recording says which user Plex uses. Leave empty to run as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group CouchElephant runs as. Match the group Plex runs as (100 is users on Unraid).

Config.Name: Hardware transcoding
Config.Description: Only for the CouchElephant DVR. Set to /dev/dri to convert recordings with an Intel or AMD GPU. Leave empty if the server has none.
